Name: Dash Strike
Description: With a deft flourish, you propel yourself up to 10 feet and then can immediately make an unarmed strike or a melee attack with a weapon you are holding against a creature within your reach. Immediately after you hit or miss with this attack, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
At Higher Levels: The distance up to which you can travel with this spell increases by 5 feet when you reach 5th level (15 feet), 11th level (20 feet), and 17th level (25 feet).
Sourcebook: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
